summary: The bad entry point reads an attacker-controlled cookie value and concatenates it directly into the HTTP "Location" response header via response.setHeader, allowing CR/LF injection (HTTP response splitting). The fix URL-encodes the untrusted value before placing it in the header, which neutralizes CR, LF, and other control characters while preserving legitimate lang values (they round-trip through the server/browser as before). The already-imported java.net.URLEncoder is used, and the enclosing method declares throws Throwable so the checked UnsupportedEncodingException is covered.
